Name: Perfect Fishing
Author: Rue7777777
Description: # Perfect Fishing ModNever struggle with the fishing minigame again! This mod automatically achieves perfect catches every time.## Features- 100% perfect catch rating on every fish- Instant progress bar completion- Works with all fishing rods and all fish types- Simple F key toggle to enable/disable- No configuration needed - works out of the box## How to Use1. Press F to enable the mod (you'll see "完美钓鱼: 开启" on screen)2. Cast your fishing rod manually3. Wait for a fish to bite4. The mod automatically catches it with perfect rating!5. Press F again to disable if needed## Requirements- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or higher## Installation1. Install SMAPI from https://smapi.io2. Download this mod3. Extract the AutoFishing folder to your Mods directory4. Launch the game through SMAPI## Known IssuesNone currently! Please report any bugs in the comments.## 📝 Changelog**v1.0.0 (2024-12-17)**- Initial release- 100% perfect catch functionality- Toggle with F key- Works on all platforms (Windows/Mac/Linux)
